rows.label: Register for the minor with the program's online application, ideally before the second semester of junior year
rows.note: Late sign-up is possible only at the directors' discretion and with a completion plan already worked out. The board cannot see registration.

rows.label: Five courses from the program's Approved Course List, 15 credits at least, each worth 3 or 4 credits
rows.note: The Approved Course List is not on the catalog page, so the board cannot tell which courses qualify. Check the program's list and confirm all five yourself.

rows.label: The five courses span at least three of the five categories, with at most two per category and at most two per department
rows.note: All ILR courses count as a single department, and a cross-listed course may count as any department it is listed in. The categories come from the off-page course list, so confirm this yourself.

rows.label: Take each minor course for a letter grade and earn B- or better
Any substitute course needs the directors' permission, petitioned before your last semester (one transfer course at most)
rows.note: Only needed if you substitute. Outside credit counts toward the minor only through this petition.

rows.label: Attend two approved events and file an event report for each by the end of that semester
Submit the Certification for Graduation Form once all five courses are done or begun
rows.note: Required for the minor to show on your transcript. Events not yet attended can be listed as to be determined.
